name: Hungry Grave (CR 2)
body:
Hungry Grave
CR 2

A petty villain was punished by being buried alive in this grave. Now his soul desires to share his misery with others.

XP 600; CE haunt (a lone grave); Caster Level 2nd; Notice Perception DC 16 (to notice the ground of the grave quaking); hp 4; Trigger proximity; Weakness slow (manifests at initiative count 0); Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, the surface of the grave starts to tremble and then suddenly collapses into a black funnel leading into a deep grave. Skeletal hands reach and claw at those who fall in. The funnel acts as a spiked pit (DC 14), except it deals slashing damage instead of piercing.

DESTRUCTION

The skeleton of the villain must be excavated, consecrated, and reburied.
